headword: {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}

definitions.gloss: sales promotion; marketing promotion; activities to boost sales
definitions.explanation: Activities and strategies designed to increase product or service sales, such as discounts, campaigns, giveaways, and advertising pushes.

examples.japanese: {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}のキャンペーンを{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: We launched a sales promotion campaign.

examples.japanese: {新商品|しんしょうひん}の{販売促進|はんばいそくしん}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れている。
examples.english: We are putting effort into promoting the new product.

examples.japanese: {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}{費|ひ}が{年間|ねんかん}{予算|よさん}の{大|おお}きな{割合|わりあい}を{占|し}めている。
examples.english: Sales promotion costs account for a large share of the annual budget.

notes:
A four-character compound of {販売|はんばい} (sales) + {促進|そくしん} (promotion, facilitation). Very commonly abbreviated to {販促|はんそく} in business conversation and internal documents. A standard term in marketing, retail, and business planning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}キャンペーン: sales promotion campaign
- {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}{費|ひ}: sales promotion expenses
- {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}{活動|かつどう}: promotional activities
- {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}{担当|たんとう}: person in charge of sales promotion
- {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れる: to put effort into sales promotion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {販促|はんそく}: sales promotion (abbreviation) — the same meaning, used more casually and frequently in daily business
- {宣伝|せんでん}: advertising, publicity — broader term focused on spreading awareness rather than directly boosting sales
- マーケティング: marketing — the overall discipline, of which sales promotion is one component
